checks.name: An empty capture cannot produce a passing CI performance report
Measured frame means and renderer budgets preserve successful CI behavior
Unavailable GPU query is explicitly skipped while available CPU checks remain usable
Profiler planning estimate cannot certify measured overhead compliance
Nonfinite and negative required frame measurements fail instead of becoming zero
Invalid renderer telemetry and measured budget excess remain failures
Capture serialization retains legacy fields and detached measured samples
Comparison refuses captures with no frame timing evidence

scope: Real production profiler/capture modules with specified timing and renderer telemetry inputs. These validate evidence semantics, not target-device performance.
